Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Data Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show these required points: knowledge of the general principles of Data Warehousing and Data Lakes, knowledge of Python, and experience with GCP or another cloud provider.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
